dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Veterans Affairs employees in homeless programs and veterans who are homeless or at risk of homelessness with mental health issues.
dimensions.evidence: veterans who are homeless and at-risk for homelessness and who have mental health issues

dimensions.assessment: Establishes procedural requirements for health needs assessment, care planning, housing identification, and electronic health record updates.
dimensions.evidence: conduct an assessment of the veteran that shall include-- (1) an assessment of the physical and mental health needs of the veteran; (2) a plan to address the immediate and long-term mental and physical needs of the veteran; and (3) an identification of appropriate housing

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific spending or revenue amounts.
Amends title 38 of the United States Code to add new administrative requirements within VA homeless programs.
